description: Core security checks applicable to any ai-control-plane client

rules.name: env_file_detection
rules.description: Detects .env files that may contain credentials
rules.message: .env file detected - may contain credentials. Contents NOT read.
rules.remediation: Add .env to .gitignore; move credentials to a secrets manager

rules.name: secret_pattern_scan
rules.description: Scans config/agent files for secret-like patterns without reading values
rules.message: Secret-like pattern found (key name only - value not shown)
rules.remediation: Remove secret from file; use environment variables or secrets manager

rules.name: missing_adapter
rules.description: Checks that adapter.json exists and is valid JSON

rules.name: missing_protected_paths
rules.description: Checks that protected-paths.json exists and is non-empty

rules.name: agents_md_protected
rules.description: Checks that AGENTS.md is in the protectedPaths list
rules.remediation: Add AGENTS.md to protectedPaths in protected-paths.json

rules.name: missing_precommit_hook
rules.description: Checks that the git pre-commit hook is installed
rules.message: pre-commit hook missing - protected-path enforcement inactive

rules.name: prompt_injection_scan
rules.description: Scans markdown files for known prompt-injection phrases
rules.remediation: Review file; ensure phrase is quoted/escaped if intentional reference

rules.name: missing_session_log
rules.remediation: Ensure .agents/ directory exists and write_session_event.ps1 is used

rules.name: precommit_no_cp_reference
rules.description: Checks that the pre-commit hook references control-plane scripts
rules.message: pre-commit hook does not reference control-plane or protected-path scripts
rules.remediation: Verify hook was installed by ai-control-plane

rules.name: no_sqlite_mirror
rules.description: Checks for presence of a SQLite mirror DB
